concerns.text: FR-006/SC-006 require a non-empty logit entry for EVERY unselected rationale in `data/teacher_logits_raw.jsonl`, but T004 emits one averaged entry per prompt and validates only 'manifest line count equals the expected number of prompts'. No task covers the per-rationale entries the spec's SC-006 verifier would check; either add a task producing per-rationale logits or the spec must be narrowed (plan-level fix).

FR-006 names the artifact `data/teacher_logits_raw.jsonl`; T004 writes `data/processed/teacher_logits_raw.jsonl` (and a manifest at `data/teacher_logits_raw.jsonl.manifest`, a third path). The spec-named canonical path has no producing task — this ambiguity is the likely root of the rejected T022. Pick one canonical path and cover it.

concerns.location: tasks.md (all tasks) vs spec.md:US-2 Acceptance Scenario 3
concerns.text: US-2 scenario 3 requires 'a full trajectory log (token-level probabilities for every step) written to `outputs/trajectory_log.jsonl`'. No task produces this artifact or a token-level-probability field; T005 logs to `data/results/training_run_<run_id>.jsonl` with entropy only. Add a task/field or reconcile the spec.

FR-007 mandates 50 trajectories per prompt per condition recorded under `outputs/trajectories/`; T006 generates 20 under `data/results/trajectories/` citing only plan.md. The spec-numbered requirement (50, spec path) has no covering task and no spec amendment authorizes the reduction — a plan/spec reconciliation task or spec update is needed.

The data-model entity `data/results/human_eval_scores.csv` (three rater scores + median, per output.schema.yaml) has no producing task anywhere in T003–T012; T007 computes only the ROUGE-L proxy. Either add a task for the rater-score artifact or remove/align the contract — currently one data-model entity is entirely uncovered.

concerns.location: tasks.md:T003 vs plan.md Constitution Check III / data hygiene
concerns.text: Plan and Constitution III require raw-dataset checksums recorded under `data/raw/checksums.json`; no task in T003–T012 records checksums for the downloaded raw data. Add this to T003's verification.
